card.name: Linking words before major depressive disorder
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, of, for) right before a named condition, mostly in the phrase "drugs effective in the treatment of major depressive disorder" in antidepressant labels.

modes.label: effective in
modes.description: The word "in" after "drugs effective", ahead of "the treatment of major depressive disorder".
modes.example: Like other drugs effective<< in>> the treatment of major depressive disorder, esc

modes.label: treatment of
modes.description: The word "of" after "treatment" when the next words name major depressive disorder.
